parameters.description: Human-readable description of the {{object}}. e.g. a more detailed description of {{param|Type}}.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The desired run value that this {{object}} will be between {{param|MinValue}} and {{param|MaxValue}}.

parameters.name: Unit
parameters.description: Units in which {{param|Value}}, {{param|Value}}, {{param|MinValue}}, {{param|MaxValue}} and {{param|StepValue}} are expressed. {{datatype|expand}}.

parameters.name: StepValue
parameters.description: Number of {{param|Unit}} changes of each {{command|StepUp()}} and {{command|StepDown()}} command.

object.description: LevelController is used to model a control with a range of continuous states. These values are configurable via {{param|Value}} and measured in {{param|Unit}} and are restricted between a Min and Max values. Intensity profile - {{param|Value}} of intensity and ability to update that level through {{command|StepUp()}} and {{command|StepDown()}} commands with a configurable {{param|StepValue}}.
